purpose: Qualify closed-form endpoint derivatives of the already qualified C1R N241 base-MvG/KSATFIT RossFast face lookup before using those derivatives in the same-factorization whole-column response tangent.

qualified_parent.representation: N241 float32 bilinear log-mobility table in u=log10(-h)
qualified_parent.scope: 36 Staringreeks 2018 unimodal MvG materials, KSATFIT, H_ENPR=0, KSATEXM disabled, homogeneous 10-cm unsaturated faces, h=[-10000,-1] cm

definitions: ell=bilinear interpolation of stored log mobility
analytic_formula_inside_one_table_cell.runtime_cost: same four float32 table values already used by bilinear flux lookup plus bounded scalar arithmetic

differentiability_scope.hard_claim: strict interiors of one bilinear table cell, away from the exact equal-head shortcut
excluded_from_unique_derivative_claim: internal table-node lines where the bilinear derivative is only one-sided/piecewise
the exact equal-head shortcut branch q=K(h)
differentiability_scope.boundary_diagnostics: Count and document excluded locations; do not smooth or invent a derivative there. A later solver/runtime contract may use explicit one-sided/fail-closed semantics.

probe_design.generator: scrambled Sobol in table-cell index and within-cell fraction
probe_design.equal_head_guard: reject and deterministically replace probes where the exact equal-head shortcut would activate
probe_design.finite_difference_perturbation: head-space symmetric perturbation capped at 5 percent of distance to the nearest table-cell boundary and 5 percent of |h_a-h_b|, with nominal relative steps 1e-6 and 3e-6

hard_self_consistency_gate.reference: symmetric finite difference of the exact same C1R N241 lookup while both perturbations remain in the same table cells and away from the equal-head branch

physical_oracle_derivative_characterizat.reference: symmetric finite difference of the independent steady-Darcian oracle at the same head pairs
record: maximum absolute derivative error normalized by KSATFIT per cm
agreement between the two finite-difference step sizes
physical_oracle_derivative_characterizat.reason: J1A first proves an exact tangent of the approximate RossFast face law. Physical derivative fidelity is characterized separately and will inform later timestep/FullRichards qualification rather than being silently conflated with discrete tangent correctness.

exit_rule.pass: Persist J1A and open J1B same-factorization whole-column tangent using the unchanged C1R face law and these derivatives.
exit_rule.fail: Do not build J1B. Diagnose table derivative algebra or branch semantics without changing the already qualified face values.

scope_guards: No Class-B H_ENPR/SvG2006 closure in J1A.
